|game_text=Destiny +2 when drawn for lightsaber combat or weapon destiny. USED: ▲ [[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man]]. LOST: If you just lost a character armed with a non-[Permanent Weapon] lightsaber, lose 1 Force to take that character (or lightsaber) into hand.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Release Your Anger (V)]]; it is the current text. Other errata versions: [[Release Your Anger (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB2-64-Release_Your_Anger-PC-E2-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Release Your Anger (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Release Your Anger (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Destiny +2 with drawn for lightsaber combat or weapon destiny. USED: ▲ Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man. LOST: If you just lost a character armed with a non-[Permanent Weapon] lightsaber, lose 1 Force to take that character (or lightsaber) into hand.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 64. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Release Your Anger (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “with drawn for lightsaber combat or weapon destiny” to “when drawn for weapon or lightsaber combat destiny” and wrote the ▲ icon out as “Take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”: “Destiny +2 when drawn for weapon or lightsaber combat destiny. USED: Take Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: If you just lost a character armed with a non-[Permanent Weapon] lightsaber, lose 1 Force to take that character (or lightsaber) into hand.”.<ref name="cl-1220_64-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the release-sheet wording with “with drawn” corrected to “when drawn”; it does not carry the PC-E1 card-list wording: “Destiny +2 when drawn for lightsaber combat or weapon destiny. USED: ▲ Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man. LOST: If you just lost a character armed with a non-[Permanent Weapon] lightsaber, lose 1 Force to take that character (or lightsaber) into hand.”.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=38, page 38. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=38 Internet Archive]</ref>
